name: Revathi Equipment India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2020, Revathi Equipment India Ltd designs and manufactures drilling rigs (drilling equipment)[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
REIL is a part of Renaissance Group. It is an ISO 9001-2008 certified manufacturer of blast hole drills and water well drills for various applications like mining, construction, water well, exploration, etc., and provides customized designs for customer-specific requirements. It has manufactured & sold over 1000 drilling rigs worldwide.

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 25.5 days to 15.6 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Earnings include an other income of Rs.11.9 Cr.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
